# Gutty

> Gutty is a healthy-food kitchen in Egypt. It cooks sourdough burgers, chicken and beef bowls, breakfast, salads and sugar-free sweets, sized to each customer's calorie target and delivered daily. Slogan: "Your Key to Gut Comfort".

## Key facts
- Website: https://minaeliaa.github.io/gutty/
- Delivery areas: Greater Cairo, Giza, 6th of October and Hadayek October, Sheikh Zayed, New Cairo, Alexandria (up to Agami)
- Ordering: WhatsApp +20 106 530 2770, or the Talabat, Breadfast and Rabbit delivery apps
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gutty.eg/
- Plans: 5 days a week x 4 weeks, 7 days a week x 4 weeks, or 7 days (one week). Chicken bowl from EGP 278 per meal, beef bowl from EGP 317 per meal (7-day, 4-week plan).
- Add-ons: daily breakfast and dinner; sugar-free dessert.
- Portions: 120 g protein and 200 g carbs per bowl; 3 toppings and a sauce of your choice.
- Freeze: up to 14 days a month with a day's notice. Refunds: only within the first 2 weeks.
- Calorie target: calculated with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, adjusted for activity and weight-loss pace.

## FAQ
- Q: How big are the portions?
  A: Standard portions are 120 g protein (8 pieces of shrimp) and 200 g carbs. Less carbs is free; more is priced by Gutty. 
- Q: Where do you deliver?
  A: Greater Cairo and Giza; 6th of October and Hadayek October; Sheikh Zayed; New Cairo; Alexandria, up to Agami; Other areas: message Gutty before subscribing.
- Q: Can I pause my plan?
  A: Yes. Freeze up to 14 days a month with a day's notice, and your subscription extends by the same number of days. 
- Q: How much is delivery?
  A: Delivery fees depend on your area and are confirmed by Gutty. 
- Q: Can I get a refund?
  A: Refunds are possible only within the first 2 weeks. 
- Q: How is my calorie target set?
  A: Your sex and age; Your height and weight; Your activity level: desk job, training 2 to 4 times a week, or 5 or more; Your pace: slow, moderate or hard.
- Q: What do I need to subscribe?
  A: Your full name; Your WhatsApp number; Your full address and area; Your preferred start date; Any allergies or dislikes; Email (optional).
- Q: How do I pay?
  A: Online by Visa or Mastercard; Mobile wallet; Fawry; InstaPay; Your subscription is tied to your registered name and address.
